args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money claimed banker's rounding in its docstring but actually
used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly test tests/test_money.py to
fail. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66,
matching the FIN-212 spec.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` quantizes with `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming banker's rounding. This broke the half-even test cases (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Fix
- Changed the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, aligning the implementation with its documented behavior (FIN-212).

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch: **passed** (all tests green, including `test_half_even`).

Review requested from @alex. Merge requires code-owner approval per policy.
